Commentary.Commentary: Kevin O'Brien was the standout bowler for Ireland with a 4-fer, three of those coming in first three overs of his first spell itself. Mulder and McBrine were impressive too in the middle overs while Dockrell was tidy as well. However, the Irish would be very disappointed at having let Afghanistan off the hook. Still a mystery as to why Kevin O'Brien was held back for long. The target looks modest but Ireland will need a good start on what seems a two-paced surface. Join us in a while for the chase.

Excellent recovery by Afghanistan. Quite similar to the previous game although they couldn't get as big a score this time. The hosts were tottering at 83/7 in the 24th over with the Irish bowlers led by Kevin O'Brien breathing fire. There was a danger of folding for a low score but the Afghans found heroes with the bat. Nabi and Shafiqullah played crucial knocks to steady ship while Zadran played a cameo to push the total to a very competitive 220-run mark.

OUT! Hamza walks! Murtagh bangs in a short delivery outside off, Hamza comes down the track to hoick it across the line but it goes off something to the keeper who takes the catch. Hamza feels he has nicked one and shows good sportsman spirit to walk back. That's it, AFGHANISTAN ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 220!
SIX! Hamza having some fun now! Murtagh receives a length ball, he gets under it and goes bang over long on for half a dozen.
Angling a short ball on middle, Zadran pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower one around middle, Zadran looks to paddle scoop it but finds Kevin O'Brien at short fine leg.
FOUR! What a strike! Touch short and angling in, Dawlat Zadran is onto it in a flash as he pulls it towards square leg. He's hit it in the gap and starts the final over with a bang.
Fuller in length and outside off, drilled down to long off where Porterfield comes across to his right and makes a diving stop to stop a certain boundary. A single taken. 9 off the over!
FOUR! What a shot, this is clean hitting! Fuller in length and outside off, Zadran goes after it as he slams it over extra cover to find the fence.
Short ball, angling in on the body, pulled along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down the track but ends up hitting it back to Kevin.
A low full toss outside off, the batsman hits it down to long off for a single.
Very full outside off, Zadran doesn't offer any stroke but why?

Wide! Another wide! On a length and in the line outside off, Zadran looks to go after it but then leaves it alone. Didn't look like a wide but umpire Anil Chaudhary gives it. Line belongs to the umpire, so it's a fair call.
Wide! Sprays it wide outside off, Dawlat has got nothing to do with it.
Very full outside off, pushed with soft hands towards covers.
Yorker outside off, jammed out towards covers and runs one. 200 up for Afghanistan!
Fuller on off, patted back to the Murtagh again.
Good length ball on off, pushed back to Tim.
Slower one outside off, Zadran hits it down to long off. They don't run.
Shortish in length and staying a bit low, flicked down to fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a good length and outside off, Hamza looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads which rolls just past the stumps.

OUT! Kevin O'Brien breaks the 57-run stand! This man can do no wrong today.  A low full toss dipping in on the hips, Mohammad Nabi just looks to help it off the hips. He whips it but not cleanly and it goes straight down the throat of Stuart Thompson at deep square leg. Will Afghanistan cross the 200-run mark? Meanwhile, Amir Hamza is the last man in.
Slower in pace and served outside off, Nabi lofts it over extra cover for a brace.
Fuller outside off, knocked down to long on for a single.
KEVIN O'BRIEN is back.
On a length and outside off, Nabi looks to dab it down to third man but it beaten by the lack of pace there.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven straight to mid off for a brisk single.
Fuller on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Jags back in from middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball outside off, Zadran looks to hit it away on the off side but gets beaten.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
TIM MURTAGH is back on.
Goes back to work but the ball comes slowly and takes it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket for a single.
50-run stand between Nabi and Zadran.

FOUR! In the air... dropped! Full and around off, Zadran clears his front leg and heaves it down the ground towards long on. Ed Joyce there dives to his right but the ball does not stick and much to his dismay the ball rolls away to the fence for a boundary.
Flattish on outside off, Nabi flays it through point for a single.
Short and around off, slashed away through covers for a single.
Slows it through the air around off, Zadra comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Drops it short on middle, Nabi transfers his weight on the back foot and pulls it towards mid-wicket for just a single.
GEORGE DOCKRELL returns!
Loopy delivery around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flattish around off, dabbed towards short third man for a single.
Tossed up around off, Dawlat defends it by lunging forward.
Slower through the air around off, Zadran defends it down gently.
Floats it up around middle, milked down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Reverse sweep! Tossed up outside off, Nabi gets into the postion early and reverse sweeps it over the keeper for a boundary towards third man to start the over.
Floated on a length outside off, gets back and blocks it solidly.
Drifting in from outside off, rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter outside off, stays back and punches it towards cover.
Flighted outside off, reaches out and defends it towards cover.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends it to the off side.
Floated outside off, Zadran drills it down to long off for a single.
Flatter outside off, gets back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends it to cover for a sharp single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from around middle, clipped gently towards mid-wicket.
Fuller around middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends well.

SIX! HAMMERED! Floated around off, steps out and launches it down the ground over long off for a maximum. Clean strike and it sails over the ropes comfortably. This man does pack a punch with big hits.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Floated around middle, worked gently towards short mid-wicket.
Floated around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Powerplay 3 signalled. Maximum 5 fielders are now allowed outside the circle...
Fuller around off, leans across and works it to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, rocks back and blocks it solidly.
Floated around off, defends it solidly from the crease.

POOR FROM IRELAND! Floated around off, leans across and clips it towards short mid-wicket for a single. Needless throw at the keeper's end but it is wayward and the ball goes to the fence for a boundary.
Flighted around off, leans forward and defends it solidly.
Flatter around off, gets on the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
THAT WAS CLOSE! Floated around off, Nabi looks to work across the line but gets a leading edge that just flies past short cover to the deep for a single.
Loopy and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Floated outside off, taps it towards point for a single.
Flatter outside off, Nabi leans into it and defends solidly.
Tossed up outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
GEORGE DOCKRELL is back!
Floated around middle, worked gently behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flighted around middle, driven down the track and it rebounds off Zadran towards short mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and leg, gets back and clips it to the leg side for a single.
Flighted around off, reaches out to that one and defends it solidly down the track.
Drops it short around middle, gets back and pulls it in front of square on the leg side. Mistimed shot and picks up a single.
Full and around off, blocked off the inside half towards square leg.
PAUL STIRLING into the attack now!
Drinks are on the field...
Fuller on the stumps, leans across and drives it down the ground to long on for a single.
Floated around leg stump, steps out to play the lofted stroke but miscues it towards wide long on. Lands safe as the batsmen get a single.
Flatter outside off, stays back to cut and chops it to point.
Drifting in from outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Flighted outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.

FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Floated around off, gets across to that one and sweeps it in front of square on the leg side. The deep mid-wicket fielder tries to save it by running to his right but cannot reach it at all.
Fuller outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks it solidly.
Loopy and wider outside off, reaches out and defends solidly.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pats it towards cover.
Drifting in from around middle, gets across to sweep but is struck on the pads.
Flatter outside off, stays back and blocks it towards cover.
Quicker ball outside off, stays back and defends solidly.
ABI ESCAPES! Floated around off, pushes at the leg break but is beaten as that spins sharply across the edge. It almost kissed the off pole on its way through to the keeper.
Flatter outside off, stays back and defends it well.
Fuller outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Loopy outside off, gets back and jabs it towards point.
Flighted outside off, leans into it and pats gently towards short cover.
Drags it short outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy outside off, Zadran gets forward and pushes it to point.
Floated outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
On a length outside off, gets back and defends it well.
Drifting in from outside off, stays back and blocks it solidly.
Loopy outside off, Nabi rocks back and steers it to point.
Floated outside off, gets back and taps it to point.
GEORGE DOCKRELL is back into the attack as well!
DAWLAT ZADRAN walks in next!

OUT! SHAFIQULLAH DEPARTS! Such a huge wicket this for Ireland as he was threatening to take his side to a fighting score. Plays back to this slider from Mulder and is struck on the pads. Looks plumb to the naked eye and up goes the umpire's finger. Handy knock from Shafiqullah, he has certainly helped Afghanistan avoid the embarrassment of a very low total.
Floated on a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Spears it well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.

FOUR! SMACK! Shafiqullah is playing an absolute gem here. Punishing anything loose. Half-tracker and he sits back to maul the pull over mid-wicket to pick up another boundary. Ireland are letting this slip here. This could be a low scoring game and you cannot afford to give freebies.
FOUR! SHOT! Floated around off, leans across and nails the slog sweep over mid-wicket. Clean strike and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Floated on a length outside off, spinning away, gets back and cuts it towards backward point for a single.
Loops it up around off, driven to the left of the bowler.
Flatter one around off, Shafiquallah hangs back in defense.
Allows it to come on the bat and nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out gently.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up outside off, Nabi gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards square leg for a boundary. He's picking his shots well and getting full value for it.
Flattish on middle, knocked down to long on for a single.
Quicker around the pads, flicked towards the leg side for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, defended into the ground.
Drops it short on middle, pulled away towards wide long on for a couple.
Pushed through quicker through the air, it's left alone.
Loopy leg break around off, SS gets back to cut but is beaten by the away turn.
Tossed up wide outside off, Shafiquallah gets down to sweep but misses.
JACOB MULDER is back on!
Flighted delivery around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Tossed up around off, Nabi looks to flick but gets it off the inner half towards square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Flattish around middle and leg, nudged fine down the leg side for a single.
Worked away with spin to mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up around off, it sticks off the deck as the batsman comes forward to defend. It hits him high on the bat but dies down safely.
FOUR! Swept with disdain! Tossed up outside off, Shafiqullah gets low and sweeps it hard through square leg to find the fence. What a shot!
Slower around off, once again it's defended down.
Leans forward and keeps it out.
Quicker through the air around off, Shafiqullah misses his poke as the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
Full around off, defended back to the bowler.
Darted on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Off the meat of the bat! Floats it up around middle, Shafiqullah gets down and brooms it from outside off to deep square leg for a boundary.
Spins in sharply from around off, Shafiquallah looks to defend but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Slows it up around off, patted back to the bowler.
Full and fired around off, eased down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Slips it down the leg side, Shafiqullah gets down and low and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Valuable runs these.
Driven straight to the man at short extra cover.
An arm ball, sliding in, defended into the ground.
Lovely ball! Tossed up around off, it turns away sharply and squares Shafiqullah completely. Wilson misses to gather and the pair takes two byes.
A run out appeal is taken upstairs. The batsman looks in though...
Full around leg, defended by lunging forward.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Around middle and leg, flicked straight to short fine leg.
FOUR! Nicely done! Deft touch! Short and flatter outside off, Shafiqullah goes back, uses the pace and steers it past the man at short third man for a boundary. The 100 is up for Afghanistan.
Full around off, driven through covers for a single.
A shout for LBW! Tossed up outside off, Nabi looks to sweep by getting across but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the impact was well outside the line.
Flighted ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up around off, swept straight to short fine leg.
Slower through the air around off, defended back to George.
FIVE WIDES! A quicker ball down the leg side, Shafiqullah misses his sweep and so does the keeper, Wilson. The ball races to the fence and Afghanistan need more of those.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Bad ball and duly punished! Slips it down the leg side, Shafiqullah gets down low and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Around middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Short and spins in a touch, tapped away towards covers for a single.

FOUR! Shafiqullah doesn't care if it's a Hat-trick ball! He just shimmies down to the pitch of the delivery and drills it down the ground past mid on for a boundary to spoil the over. But McBrine wouldn't mind that.
SHAFIQULLAH SHAFIQ is the new man in to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Rashid Khan, gone first ball! Two-in-two for McBrine! Tossed up around middle, Rashid Khan lunges forward and across to flick but misses it completely and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal follows and the the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Afghanistan are falling like a pack of cards here. What's happening?
RASHID KHAN is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... gone! What a catch from Andy Balbirnie! Tossed up around off, Asghar Stanikzai comes down the track to go downtown but it goes off the inner half of the bat and flat towards long on. Balbirnie stationed there times his leap to perfection and grabs it out the the thin air. The Irishmen know the importance of this wicket. Afghanistan lose their captain against the run of play.
Floats it up outside off, defended into the ground gently.
Around middle and leg, Mohammad drives it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, turning in as MN looks to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Asghar misses his flick.
Takes a good stride forward and drives it down to long off for a single.
An arm ball, skidding through the deck, Nabi comes forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. No appeal as it was clearly going down leg.
Full on the stumps, defended towards the leg side.
Quicker through the air around middle, Mohammad looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Loopy delivery around middle, skidding through the surface, Nabi defends it down.
GEORGE DOCKRELL into the attack now!
Very full on the stumps, eased down to long on for one.
Loopy delivery around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Tossed up around middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Flat and short outside off, crunched a bit square on the off side for a single.
Wide! Drops it down the leg side, Asghar leaves it alone.
Loopy ball around off, Stanikzai gets across and defends it down the track.
Drifting in on the pads, flicked towards the man at short fine leg.
Slower through the air outside off, driven through sweeper cover for another single. End of a successful over!
Floats it up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
MOHAMMAD NABI is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! That's a brain fade from Naib! Mulder hurls in a slider and it straightens a touch, Gulbadin Naib goes back to cut but then for some reason leaves it alone. He gets hit on the pads and they appeal confidently for an LBW. The umpire rules him out but replays show it would have missed the stumps. Maybe, the umpire thought it was a wrong 'un and hence favoured the bowler. Nonetheless,  half the Afghani side back in the hut now.
Drifting in from outside off, leans forward and pats it towards short cover.
Slightly short outside off, rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Beaten! Naib looks to defend but is beaten by the leg break that spins past the edge.
Second slip now in place. Good captaincy.
Drifting in from around middle, gets across and blocks it firmly on to the track.

FOUR! Excellent stroke from the captain! Flighted ball outside off from around the wicket, width on offer and Stanikzai spans the drive through the covers. Gets it well right of the sweeper cover fielder and finds the fence.
Loopy and wider outside off, Stanikzai reaches out and pats it to short cover.
Loopy around off, leans across and works it down to long on for a single.
Flighted outside off, presses forward to that one and smothers it to the ground.
Flighted outside off, holds its line after pitching and Naib is beaten on the push.
Top delivery! Mulder is getting into his groove now. Quicker leg break and it spins across Stanikzai to beat the edge.
Quicker ball outside off, Naib is beaten on the cut. Wilson fumbles and allows a bye.
Flatter ball outside off, Stanikzai gets back and pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently towards cover.
FOUR! SMASHED! Long hop from Mulder and Stanikzai sits on the back foot to pull it powerfully over mid-wicket. Excellent strike and it goes to the fence for a boundary. He pounced on it in a jiffy.

FOUR! EDGED BUT SAFE! A second slip may have gobbled that up. Loopy leg break wider outside off, Stanikzai goes for a flashy drive and gets a thick edge that goes well wide of second slip as it goes to the third man fence. Lucky escape for the skipper.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and defends solidly.
Flatter outside off, Stanikzai gets back and pushes it through the covers for a single.
Floated outside off, Stanikzai defends it solidly with a straight bat.
Slightly short around middle, more turn for McBrine and this time it's again clipped towards short fine leg.
Floated around middle, works it with the spin towards short fine leg.
GULBADIN NAIB walks in next, replacing Shahidi!

OUT! RIPPER FROM MULDER! Lovely leg break outside off, sharp turn into the left-hander as Shahidi looks to drive. The extravagant spin makes the ball sneak through bat and pad to crash into the stumps. Dream ball for any leg spinner and this is a timely strike for Ireland as this pair was trying to repair the early damage.
Huge appeal but turned down! Too much turn perhaps. The leg break around off, spins in sharply to rap the front pad as Shahidi looks to block.
Half-tracker around off, keeps a bit low as Shahidi mistimes the pull to short mid-wicket.
Drags it short outside off, sits on the back foot and cuts it away to sweeper cover for a single.
Slightly short outside off, spinning away, no shot offered by Stanikzai.
Flatter around middle, worked with the turn to square leg for a single.
Drinks break....
Pushed through quicker on the sticks, Shahidi drives it down to long on for a single.
Speared in around off, Shahidi pats it towards the point region. Wants the single but is sent back.
Floated around off, Shahidi pushes it towards the covers.
Floated around off, Shahidi pushes it towards the covers.
Flatter ball around middle, Shahidi is cramped for room and he jams it down the track.
Flighted around middle, leans into it and defends solidly on to the pitch.
Slightly short outside off, crunched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Drifting in from around off, Shahidi presses forward and blocks.
Erratic leg break and it spins down the leg side. Wide called.
Flatter and outside off, Stanikzai stays back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated outside off, sits on the back foot and blocks firmly.
Floated around leg stump, cheeky little paddle to short fine leg for a single.
Flighted around off, leans into it and blocks it well.

FOUR! Flighted wider outside off, lures Stanikzai into the drive and he strikes it really well through the covers. Thompson in the deep put in a desperate dive but couldn't prevent the boundary. Good commitment nevertheless.
Floated outside off, uses his feet and clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Floated around off, Stanikzai gets across and works it with the turn to short mid-wicket.
Drifting on to the pads, Shahidi works it through square leg for a single.
SHARP TURN! Lovely off break outside off, turns away to beat the outside edge as Shahidi looks to block.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly off the front foot on to the pitch.
Time for spin from both ends as ANDREW MCBRINE comes into the attack!
Loopy outside off, leans forward and defends it solidly.
Poor ball from Mulder as he drops it short around middle, Shahidi rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for just a single. Missed out there.
Floated fuller outside off, Shahidi pummels the drive through the covers. Good diving stop near the ropes by the fielder to keep the batsmen down to two.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
Floated outside off, Stanikzai goes for the cut but is beaten as that skids off the deck.
Floated outside off, Shahidi goes for the expansive drive but gets a thick inside edge just past the stumps as it goes to square leg for a single.
Five Wides! Erratic from Mulder. The leg break around leg stump, spins down the leg side as Shahidi misses the flick. Wilson misses it too and it races away down to the fine leg fence. Bonus runs.
Length ball outside off, punched firmly off the back foot towards short cover.
Good length angled into the right-hander, tight line and Stanikzai defends solidly from the crease.
Fuller and angled in around off, blocked solidly off the front foot towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, Stanikzai looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
Fuller ball outside off, glorious drive through the covers by Shahidi but he will get just a single as there is protection in the deep.
Length ball outside off, Shahidi presses forward and dabs it towards short point.
Flighted around off, wristed away with the spin down to long on for a run.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Mulder drops it short around middle, Shahidi is quick to pounce on the offering and rocks back to launch the pull over mid-wicket. Just on the bounce to the fence.
Floated around leg stump, Shahidi misses the sweep and the ball rolls to short fine leg. Appeal for lbw but it was pitching outside leg.
Drifting in from around leg stump, Shahidi leans across to nudge it gently towards short fine leg.
Slightly short outside off, rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up fuller around middle, squeezed out towards short cover.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled! Minimum 4 fielders allowed outside the circle. Also, JACOB MULDER will roll his arm.
Fuller and hurled across the batsman, Shahidi shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller length ball, curling back into the batsman who stays put and offers a dead bat defense.
Cuts back in from a length, tucked through square leg for an easy single.
On a good length and moves away a touch, the Afghan skipper punches it towards the man at short extra cover.
Pitches it right up there, Stanizkai shows patience and defends it by lunging forward.
Good length ball on middle and off, Stanikzai gets behind it and punches it towards mid on.
Back of a length ball outside off, tapped towards the point fielder.
Fuller outside off, driven hard but it goes straight to the man at covers.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Kevin O'Brien errs his line and slips it down the leg side, it's on a shorter side, Shahidi swivels and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Shortish on middle, defended by covering the line.
Fuller outside off, slightly overpitched as well, driven straight to mid off for nothing.
On a length and on middle, Stanikzai comes down the track and drags his pull off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, Shahidi once again allows it to go through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball outside off, the batsman stays put and taps it towards covers.
On a length and around off, HS shoulders his arms to that one.

What a stop! Saved a certain boundary! On a length and outside off, gives a bit of width as well as Shahidi pounces on it. Gets back and cuts it hard but William Porterfield at point dives to his left to stop it. Good intent on the field from Ireland today.
Wide outside off, Hashmatulluah leaves it alone.
Fuller and curling back in, clipped through square leg for one.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards extra cover.

FOUR! A chance goes down begging! On a good length and moves away off the deck, Shahidi looks to cut but gets an outside edge. Wilson behind the stumps was late to react and the ball flew past him to the third man fence for a boundary. Lucky escape for Shahidi here.
On middle and leg, worked towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Gets on the front foot and drives it once again towards mid off for nothing.
Wide! Sprays it wide outside off, the batsman has got nothing to do with that one.
Good length, wide outside off, easy leave for Shahidi.
Comes from around the wicket and pitches it up on off, driven towards mid off.
FOUR! First boundary of the bat! Fuller length ball on off, Asghar Stanikzai gets across and flicks it wide of the mid on fielder and picks up a much-needed boundary to end the over.
Touch fuller and hurled outside off, driven towards the man at mid off.
Back of a length ball on middle, Asghar once again gets down the track to pull but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Back of a length ball on middle, defended with a straight bat.
Takes a stride forward and drives it towards mid off.
Wide! Stanikzai comes down the track to pull it away but the bowler slips it down the leg side. The batsman fails to get going with the shot.

Another shout for LBW! On a length and this one nips back in sharply as the Afghan skipper misses his flick and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal but the umpire turns it down. Maybe, height was an issue there.
Good length ball outside off, defended off the front foot. A wicket maiden for Kevin O'Brien!
HASHMATULLAH SHAHIDI is the new batsman in!

OUT! Straight to Mulder! Kevin O'Brien is breathing fire! Hurls it on a length and just outside off, Usman Ghani comes down the track and tries to flat bat it over the off side but doesn't get enough on it. It goes straight to Mulder at short extra cover who takes a reverse cup catch near his face. Ireland are off to a flier here.
Fuller in length and angling in on middle, it's pushed towards the man at mid on.
Good length ball on middle, UG closes the face of the bat and ends up hitting it back to the bowler again.
Fuller in length and moving away, Ghani comes across and pats it back to the bowler again.
Full outside off, bunted back to Kevin.
Beaten! On a length and just outside off, Asghar comes forward to defend but the ball straightens a bit and almost takes the outside edge to the keeper.
Gets forward and drills it towards covers.
Good length ball, coming in on middle, Asghar gets back and tucks it through backward square leg. The fielder cuts it off but they get a couple till then, good running!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drifting on the pads, nudged fine down the leg side for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, Ghani closes the face of early and as a result gets a leading edge towards point.
Fuller and this doesn't rise off the deck, AS lets is pass.
Good length outside off, Asghar looks to cut it away but there is not enough width and he gets beaten.
On the pads, Usman flicks it through square leg for a single.

Fuller and strayed on the pads, Stanikzai flicks it off his pads towards short fine leg where the fielder puts in a dive to his right to stop it. A single taken and the Afghan skipper opens his account.
ASGHAR STANIKZAI is the new man in. The skipper walks out when his team is under immense pressure. Can he deliver today?

OUT! Rahmat Shah bags a duck! Kevin O'Brien has another, he's on a roll here! Serves it full and it moves away a shade, Rahmat Shah looks to drive it away on the off side but it goes off something to the keeper behind who takes the catch. Irealand put in an appeal but umpire Anil Chaudhary asks them to wait and asks the help from the TV umpire. After seeing a lot of replays the third umpire feels there was a slight nick and that was enough to send Rahmat Shah back to hut. Afghanistan have been rocked early here.
Rahmat Shah seems to have been caught behind. The umpires want to be sure and sends it upstairs. The soft signal appears to be out from the body language of Anil Chaudhary.
Fuller length delivery outside off, pushed towards the man at covers.
Comes forward a bit and pushes it towards mid on. A maiden to start with for Murtagh!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Length ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, Ghani leaves it alone for the keeper.

A loud shout for LBW, turned down! That was close though! Touch fuller and this one jags back in to ping Ghani on the back pad right in front of the stumps. Murtagh pleads for an appeal and continues to do so but the umpire turns it down. Irealand are right on money here.
TIM MURTAGH to take the other new ball.
Fuller in length and on middle, driven straight to the man at mid on. End of a superb first over!
Fuller and served wide outside off, driven nicely but finds the man at short extra cover.
RAHMAT SHAH is the new man in.

OUT! Kevin O'Brien draws first blood! Shahzad departs cheaply again, it's a big blow to the hosts! Hurls in a fuller length delivery, it nips back in a shade, Shahzad looks to flick it across the line but misses and is rapped on the pads. Kevin turns back and appeals long and hard. The umpire after taking his time raises the finger. What a start for the Irishmen!
Touch fuller and angling in again, Ghani looks to work it away on the leg side but gets it off the inner half in front of square for a single.

FOUR BYES! Fuller in length and wide outside off, it stays low as well. Ghani looks to cut it away on the off side but misses and so does the keeper. The ball races down to the fence for a boundary. Good start for the hosts.
Afghanistan are away! Fuller in length and angling in on the pads, Shahzad flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a single to get off the mark.
Players and umpires are out there in the middle. MOHAMMAD SHAHZAD and USMAN GHANI to open the batting for Afghanistan. It shall be KEVIN O'BRIEN to start proceedings.

WILLIAM PORTERFIELD says even he wanted to bat first but now feels they would look to restrict them again. Feels the pitch would remain decent throughout as seen in the last game. Informs KEVIN O'BRIEN and JACOB MULDER come in place for Chase and Niall O'Brien. Further says that their mental strength didn't wane despite the earlier losses and made some good improvements in the last match. Hopes his team levels the series today.

ASGHAR STANIKZAI says that Afghanistan will bat first. Feels that it is a good pitch and will turn later, so they want to make use of the better batting conditions. Feels that they played a few poor shots in the last game and will look to correct it. Reveals two changes - SHAHIDI and GHANI come in for Noor Ali and Shenwari.
TOSS - Afghanistan win the toss and opt to bat!

PITCH REPORT - Chetan Sharma says that there are some cracks on the pitch and it's a very used surface which means that it will get slower as the game progresses with good help for the spinners. Team winning the toss must bat first.

Hello and a warm welcome for 4th ODI between Afghanistan and Ireland in Greater Noida. The Irishmen after having a tough time finally managed to register a win under their belt in the previous ODI and with that they have kept the series alive. Afghanistan on the other hand will be disappointed with the loss and would look to come out hard and seal the deal. But with momentum not in their favour, we can expect Porterfield and company to replicate their last performance. Will the Afghans seal the series? Or will Ireland take it to the decider? Stay with as the toss and team updates will be coming in a short while.
